# name<TAB>generic<TAB>ground.  Columns are tab-separated; a row's GROUND

# reason is a guess that reads like a fact.
# The names are not chosen here: scripts/cst-regmap.py reads them out of the
# target's own registration sites and REFUSES to generate if this file is
# short a name or carries one the target never registers.
